rationale:
REVISION (round 2) of fa4ec9c8. Round 1 was REVISE decided_by "unreadable reviewer(s): review_editquality.result" — one seat's unparseable output, not a judgement (5 approve, 2 object, 1 unreadable). I read decided_by before touching anything. Both real objections were worth acting on and ONE FOUND A GENUINE HOLE, so this is a materially different plan, not a re-argued one.

1) GUARDIAN edit 3 (low) — "doesn't establish there are no other LogLLMCall call sites". IT WAS RIGHT AND MY PLAN WAS WRONG. Enumerated tree-wide:
  grep -rn "LogLLMCall(" --include=*.go . | grep -v _test.go | grep -v "func LogLLMCall"
  -> ai_actions.go:458, 669                          (the two I had)
  -> companies_house_llm_review_action.go:163, 191   (MISSED)
  -> vet_med_price_scrape_action.go:1225, 1253, 1284 (MISSED)
SEVEN, not two. vet_med hardcodes Provider: "ollama" at all three sites (grep: `Provider:        "ollama"` x3) and can never produce thinking, so NULL is correct there. companies_house reads its provider from config (`if p, ok := aiServiceConfig["provider"].(string); ok`) and CAN be pointed at Gemini — it would have logged NULL thinking on a real thinking call, silently. That is precisely the "one call site of a shared judgement gets the rigorous fix; the sibling stays heuristic" shape this council's own 016b section 9 names, and bugs_open/093 is titled for.

FIXED STRUCTURALLY, not by patching five sites: the four settable interface{} fields are GONE, replaced by ONE `Options map[string]interface{}` holding the same map the caller passed to GenerateText, with LogLLMCall deriving the four values itself. Four separate fields make "I updated three of them" and "this site sets none" both representable and both silent; a single map cannot be partially populated. Forgetting it yields four honest NULLs rather than a mix. companies_house's two sites now pass it. This makes the bad state unrepresentable rather than documented.

I ALSO FOUND A BUG OF MY OWN while making that change: round 1 read the options map INSIDE the logging goroutine. LogLLMCall is fire-and-forget and the caller may reuse or mutate that map after it returns — a data race I introduced. The extraction now happens before the goroutine starts.

2) GUARDIAN edit 2 (medium) — "I want it named as a checked risk, not just narrated". Fair; it WAS checked, I simply had not shown the check:
  - 26 columns / 26 placeholders, contiguous $1..$26 (parsed out of the source, not eyeballed).
  - All 26 names confirmed present in information_schema.columns for llm_call_log.
  - The EXACT statement executed against the live table inside BEGIN...ROLLBACK: INSERT 0 1, the row read back as max_tokens=8000, wire=16192, reserve=8192, thinking_tokens=0, total=7105, then 0 rows left behind. thinking_tokens=0 surviving as 0 rather than NULL is the design decision proven against the real table rather than argued.

3) PRIOR_ART edit 0 (medium) — the absence claim was mine and asserted, and this seat was right that a declarations-only content index cannot settle it either way. A tree-wide grep can. Re-run on all four literals, every hit listed: the ONLY non-test readers are platform/aiservice/gemini.go (the writer, lines 327/328/410/411) and platform/orchestration/actions/llm_call_logger.go (this change). Before this change: zero readers outside platform/aiservice/. Confirmed independently of my original grep.

4) PRIOR_ART edit 0 (low) — llm_call_log's schema was not available to the seat, so the DB evidence was accepted on say-so. The relevant columns, from information_schema: max_tokens integer NULL, output_tokens integer NULL, and the four added by this migration — wire_max_output_tokens, thinking_reserve_tokens, thinking_tokens, total_output_tokens, all integer NULL. The single write path is the INSERT in llm_call_logger.go quoted in edit 3's sketch.

5) GUARDIAN edit 5 (low) — verify my account of 107's council rather than take it. Read from the record: corr a1a5cf20 decided "approved with 4 advisory objection(s) — none high-severity". So 107's plan WAS approved and the "visible to logging" claim did survive that review unchallenged, which is what I asserted. I am not claiming the seats erred on the plan they were shown; I am claiming the overclaim was in the prose and nothing in the process catches prose.

NOT CLAIMED: that this makes cost correct or complete — it makes it measurable. Still INERT: v1.0.1180 does NOT carry it (pod-grep: the INSERT is present via rag_context_used/prompt_variant at 1, my total_output_tokens at 0). Needs an image built at or after HEAD.

plan.summary: Persist the four thinking-model telemetry values gemini.go already computes: four nullable integer columns on llm_call_log, read at both LogLLMCall sites, preserving the nil-vs-zero distinction the columns depend on.

edits.rationale: Four nullable integer columns. Nullable because NULL means 'this provider does not report it' (anthropic, ollama), which is a real distinction from a reported zero. No index: these are aggregation targets over a provider+date range, not selective predicates, and llm_call_log already carries five indexes on a high-write table.

ONE Options field, not four settable ones — the round-1 shape let a call site populate some-but-not-all silently, and the guardian seat's enumeration found five sites that would have set none. Extraction moved out of the fire-and-forget goroutine: the caller may mutate the map after LogLLMCall returns, which was a data race in round 1.

Extend the INSERT to 26 placeholders and pass the four through WITHOUT nullIfZero(), which every neighbouring int uses. That helper maps 0 to NULL and would make a reported zero indistinguishable from an unreported one.
edits.sketch:
temperature, max_tokens
+				, wire_max_output_tokens, thinking_reserve_tokens
+				, thinking_tokens, total_output_tokens
 			) VALUES (
-				$21, $22

edits.rationale: Five tests. The key names are a contract with gemini.go that the compiler cannot check — a typo yields nil, which is indistinguishable from a provider that reports nothing, so the column would sit quietly NULL forever. Also covers the nil/0 distinction, nil options, and a wrong-typed value.

grounded_in: platform/aiservice/gemini.go:321 (comment) — "The wire total is kept below for whoever needs it, but note it is currently PERSISTED NOWHERE: llm_call_log has no column for it, and nothing outside this package reads these keys. That is 110 candidate 2 (a migration), and until it lands, thinking cost is visible only in the truncation error — not in any query."

platform/aiservice/gemini.go:326-328 — the three sent-side keys, verbatim: options["__sent_max_tokens"] = visibleBudget / options["__sent_wire_max_output_tokens"] = totalBudget / options["__sent_thinking_reserve_tokens"] = totalBudget - visibleBudget

platform/aiservice/gemini.go:410-411 — the two usage keys, verbatim: options["__usage_thinking_tokens"] = response.UsageMetadata.ThoughtsTokenCount / options["__usage_total_tokens"] = response.UsageMetadata.TotalTokenCount. Both are set inside `if options != nil` BEFORE the finishReason and RefusalError checks below, which is why the failure path can read them.
bugs_open/110 — "**Verified by grep: none has any reader outside `platform/aiservice/`.** They reach no column and no query. This is `016b` §9's *\"a field is only as live as its LAST reader\"*"

bugs_open/110 candidate 2, verbatim — "**2 — Persist what the client already computes.** Add `visible_budget_tokens`, `thinking_reserve_tokens`, `thinking_tokens`, `total_output_tokens` to `llm_call_log`; read the four `__` fields in `ai_actions.go` and pass them through `llm_call_logger.go`." I deviate on the FIRST column name only, for the reason in the rationale.

platform/orchestration/actions/llm_call_logger.go (pre-existing helper) — "// nullIfZero returns nil for zero token counts (when provider doesn't report them)". This is the helper I deliberately do NOT use for the four new fields.

Live DB, after applying 245 (information_schema.columns on llm_call_log): wire_max_output_tokens | integer | YES, thinking_reserve_tokens | integer | YES, thinking_tokens | integer | YES, total_output_tokens | integer | YES.

Live DB, the first Gemini rows ever recorded (2026-07-27 20:09, page-content-writer building dartsonline/sale): provider=gemini, model_resolved=gemini-pro-latest, max_tokens=8000 for both. max_tokens reading 8000 rather than the reserve-inflated 16192 is bugs_open/110 candidate 1's own stated post-fix test, so candidate 1 is confirmed live and this change builds on it.

Tree-wide enumeration answering guardian edit 3 — SEVEN LogLLMCall sites: ai_actions.go:458,669; companies_house_llm_review_action.go:163,191; vet_med_price_scrape_action.go:1225,1253,1284. My plan named two.
vet_med_price_scrape_action.go:1232,1260,1291 — `Provider:        "ollama"` hardcoded at all three sites, so they can never produce thinking and four NULLs is the correct row.

companies_house_llm_review_action.go:153 — `if p, ok := aiServiceConfig["provider"].(string); ok { llmProvider = p }`, i.e. provider comes from config and CAN be gemini. This is the site that would have silently logged NULL thinking.

Tree-wide grep answering prior_art's medium objection: the only NON-TEST readers of the four keys are platform/aiservice/gemini.go:327,328,410,411 (writer) and platform/orchestration/actions/llm_call_logger.go:137-140,160-163 (this change). Zero readers outside platform/aiservice/ before it.

Live round-trip of the exact INSERT inside BEGIN...ROLLBACK, answering guardian edit 2: INSERT 0 1; row read back gemini | 8000 | 16192 | 8192 | 0 | 7105; then `rows_left_behind` = 0. thinking_tokens=0 survived as 0, not NULL.

plan.risks: The Go half is INERT until an image is built at or after HEAD; v1.0.1180 provably does not carry it (pod-grep: same-INSERT positive controls rag_context_used/prompt_variant/'work_item_id, vertical' at 1, my total_output_tokens at 0). Until then every column reads NULL, which is honest but looks like a failed feature. No backfill is possible — the values were never persisted anywhere. The four columns stay NULL forever for anthropic and ollama, so aggregates must handle NULL rather than assume 0. thinkingTelemetry's key names remain a contract with gemini.go that the compiler cannot enforce; a rename there yields nil, indistinguishable from a provider that reports nothing, and the test pinning the literals is the only guard. Removing the four exported struct fields in favour of Options is a breaking change to LLMCallLogParams, but all seven construction sites are in this package and all are updated or deliberately left nil; `go build ./platform/...` is clean. Widening the INSERT from 22 to 26 placeholders touches the single write path for every provider — it is fire-and-forget with errors logged and never blocking, so a mistake degrades logging rather than workflows, but estate-wide; hence the live round-trip above rather than a narrated assurance.
